title: Ashgrove House rota, week commencing 7 December 2026

constraints.rationale: Every slot gets exactly the number of people in its people column.

provenance.quote: rota_shifts.csv (every slot for the week and how many people each one needs)

constraints.rationale: Senior slots (meds round) only for staff whose competencies include meds; carer slots have no requirement.

provenance.quote: senior slots only for staff signed off on meds (competencies column)

constraints.rationale: Nobody works two overlapping slots (the twilight overlaps the day and the night).

provenance.quote: nobody on two shifts at once

constraints.rationale: At least eleven hours off between the end of one shift and the start of the next.

provenance.quote: at least eleven hours off between any two shifts, no exceptions

constraints.rationale: Precious is on annual leave from Thursday 10 to Saturday 12 December.

provenance.quote: Precious is on annual leave Thu 10th to Sat 12th

constraints.rationale: Gary and Rhona never work the same shift while the investigation is open.

provenance.quote: under no circumstances put Gary and Rhona on the same shift while the investigation is open

constraints.rationale: Preferably no more than three consecutive working days.

provenance.quote: ideally nobody works more than three days in a row

constraints.rationale: Everyone on a contract should get at least three shifts this week.

provenance.quote: try to give everyone on a contract at least three shifts

constraints.rationale: Bank staff should get roughly the same number of hours.

provenance.quote: share the bank hours out evenly between the bank staff

constraints.rationale: Kemi, who is doing her Care Certificate, should work the same slots as Bernadette.

provenance.quote: Kemi is still doing her Care Certificate - pair her with Bernadette on as many shifts as you can

assumptions.text: Precious's leave covers the whole of Thursday to Saturday (10 Dec 00:00 to 13 Dec 00:00), so the Wednesday night that runs into Thursday is excluded too.
A night counts on the day it starts, for days in a row and for the week.
